014791:     bool terminates = noreturn && !c_ir_lowering_resumes_after_call(builder);

014832: // Emit one compiler-runtime call whose ABI is fixed by the compiler rather
014833: // than by a source declaration. These imports are used only when the target
014834: // cannot implement an admitted operation inline; the canonical IR still owns
014835: // the call, its arguments and the external symbol identity.
014836: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_emit_runtime_call_source(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrSourceRange source, String8 link_name, IrTypeId return_type,
014837:                                                       IrTypeId* parameter_types, IrValueId* arguments, u32 argument_count,
014838:                                                       IrValueId* result_out)
014839: {
014840:     IrTypeId function_type = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
014841:     IrSymbolId symbol = IR_SYMBOL_ID_INVALID;
014842:     bool emitted = true;
014843:     for (u32 argument_index = 0; emitted && argument_index < argument_count; argument_index += 1)
014844:     {
014845:         if (arguments[argument_index].value >= builder->function->value_count ||
014846:             builder->function->values[arguments[argument_index].value].canonical_type.value != parameter_types[argument_index].value)
014847:         {
014848:             builder->failure_message = S8("a compiler runtime call argument has an incompatible canonical type");
014849:             emitted = false;
014850:         }
014851:     }
014852:     for (u32 symbol_index = 0; emitted && symbol.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && symbol_index < builder->program->symbols.count; symbol_index += 1)
014853:     {
014854:         IrSymbol* candidate = builder->program->symbols.symbols + symbol_index;
014855:         if (string_equal(candidate->link_name, link_name))
014856:         {
014857:             if (candidate->kind != IR_SYMBOL_FUNCTION)
014858:             {
014859:                 builder->failure_message = S8("a compiler runtime symbol conflicts with a non-function declaration");
014860:                 emitted = false;
014861:             }
014862:             else
014863:             {
014864:                 symbol = candidate->id;
014865:                 function_type = candidate->type;
014866:             }
014867:         }
014868:     }
014869:     if (emitted && symbol.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
014870:     {
014871:         IrType* existing = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, function_type);
014872:         bool matches = existing && existing->kind == IR_TYPE_FUNCTION && existing->calling_convention == IR_CALLING_CONVENTION_C &&
014873:                        !existing->is_variadic && !existing->is_unprototyped && existing->return_type.value == return_type.value &&
014874:                        existing->parameter_count == argument_count;
014875:         for (u32 parameter_index = 0; matches && parameter_index < argument_count; parameter_index += 1)
014876:         {
014877:             matches = existing->parameter_types[parameter_index].value == parameter_types[parameter_index].value;
014878:         }
014879:         if (!matches)
014880:         {
014881:             builder->failure_message = S8("a compiler runtime symbol has an incompatible declaration");
014882:             emitted = false;
014883:         }
014884:     }
014885:     if (emitted && symbol.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
014886:     {
014887:         IrTypeId* imported_parameters = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrTypeId, argument_count ? argument_count : 1);
014888:         for (u32 argument_index = 0; argument_index < argument_count; argument_index += 1)
014889:         {
014890:             imported_parameters[argument_index] = parameter_types[argument_index];
014891:         }
014892:         function_type = ir_program_add_type(builder->program, (IrType){
014893:             .name = S8("C compiler runtime function"),
014894:             .parameter_types = imported_parameters,
014895:             .element_type = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID,
014896:             .return_type = return_type,
014897:             .layout = {
014898:                 .size = builder->program->data_layout.pointer.size,
014899:                 .alignment = builder->program->data_layout.pointer.alignment,
014900:                 .resolved = true,
014901:             },
014902:             .kind = IR_TYPE_FUNCTION,
014903:             .calling_convention = IR_CALLING_CONVENTION_C,
014904:             .parameter_count = argument_count,
014905:         });
014906:         symbol = ir_program_add_symbol(builder->program, (IrSymbol){
014907:             .name = link_name,
014908:             .link_name = link_name,
014909:             .source = source,
014910:             .type = function_type,
014911:             .kind = IR_SYMBOL_FUNCTION,
014912:             .linkage = IR_LINKAGE_IMPORT,
014913:         });
014914:     }
014915:     emitted = emitted && symbol.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && function_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID;
014916:     IrValueId reference_result = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
014917:     IrInstructionId reference_id = IR_INSTRUCTION_ID_INVALID;
014918:     if (emitted)
014919:     {
014920:         reference_result = c_ir_add_result(builder, function_type);
014921:         IrInstruction reference = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_FUNCTION, function_type);
014922:         reference.symbol = symbol;
014923:         reference.result = reference_result;
014924:         reference_id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, reference, source);
014925:         emitted = reference_result.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && reference_id.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID;
014926:     }
014927:     IrValueId result = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
014928:     bool returns_void = false;
014929:     IrInstructionId call_id = IR_INSTRUCTION_ID_INVALID;
014930:     if (emitted)
014931:     {
014932:         builder->function->values[reference_result.value].definition = reference_id;
014933:         IrValueId* operands = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrValueId, argument_count + 1);
014934:         operands[0] = reference_result;
014935:         for (u32 argument_index = 0; argument_index < argument_count; argument_index += 1)
014936:         {
014937:             operands[argument_index + 1] = arguments[argument_index];
014938:         }
014939:         IrType* returned = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, return_type);
014940:         returns_void = returned && returned->kind == IR_TYPE_VOID;
014941:         result = returns_void ? IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID : c_ir_add_result(builder, return_type);
014942:         IrInstruction call = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_CALL, return_type);
014943:         call.operands = operands;
014944:         call.operand_count = argument_count + 1;
014945:         call.symbol = symbol;
014946:         call.result = result;
